note: Two profiles: through the Envoy gateway (:8080) and direct to the API (:8000). GET /ready, 200 requests, 8 workers.

gateway_8080.status_0_meaning: urllib raises on non-2xx; these are HTTP 429 local_rate_limited from the Envoy local rate limiter (IP08, intentionally low for the demo)

bottleneck: Gateway path is rate-limit bound by design (429s). Direct path is 100% success; latency is dominated by /ready probing every dependency synchronously on each call, and the vLLM probe adds tail latency because it hits ConnectError (no real vLLM connected). With a real vLLM endpoint or an async/cached readiness the p50 drops well below 487 ms.
